datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Nicaragua to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for each month of 2021, representing food insecurity impact assessments across administrative units.
